propositions: Copilot CLI silently drops rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, and rebar-debug skills due to invalid SKILL.md frontmatter (over-1024-char descriptions and unquoted colons in YAML).
SKILL.md description fields for rebar-implement and rebar-janitor exceed the 1024-character limit enforced by the Agent Skills spec.
rebar-debug SKILL.md contains an unquoted colon in a plain scalar (discipline: write) that breaks YAML parsing.
The repository has no deterministic CI lint to catch invalid skill frontmatter before silent failure at Copilot skill-load time.
SKILL.md frontmatter must be rewritten as YAML folded block scalars and trimmed to <= 1024 characters while preserving skill invocation triggers.
A new check_skill_frontmatter.py lint script must validate all SKILL.md files for YAML parseability, description presence/length, and name format, wired into make lint.
